Top WiFi-Friendly Cafes & Restaurants

If you hit a local outage or simply need a change of scenery, San Carlos doesn't have formal coworking spaces yet—but its cafe culture has stepped up to fill the gap. These locations offer free WiFi and a laptop-friendly environment:

  • Meri-Meri Coffee: A top choice on the main boulevard. It features plenty of power outlets, artisanal coffee, and a quiet atmosphere perfect for deep work.

  • Cafe Buena Onda: Known for its "good vibes" and friendly staff, this cafe is a digital nomad staple. The WiFi is consistent, and the food menu is excellent for long working sessions.

  • Turquesa Restaurant: If you prefer a "working brunch," Turquesa offers large tables and strong coffee. It’s perfect for those who need a bit more desk space to spread out.

  • Local Restaurants: Most eateries in town provide free WiFi. Whether you are at a seafood spot or a local diner, you can stay connected while enjoying affordable local cuisine.
